features.quote: Use trigger rate per dollar as an *efficiency* metric for running the suite, not as the thing you regression-test against.
features.justification_quote: biases your whole harness toward the most artificial, adversarial tasks... won't know if you fixed the underlying behavior or just made your specific cheap triggers stop working

features.quote: undetectable rigging is its own failure mode... you're measuring 'spirals when reality is gaslit.' Those are different behaviors with different patches.
features.justification_quote: you're not measuring 'spirals after genuine difficulty' — you're measuring 'spirals when reality is gaslit.' Those are different behaviors with different patches.

features.quote: Keep traces internal, don't fine-tune on amplifying it, and the deliverable is the *patch*, not the trigger library.
features.justification_quote: The thing you're inducing is distress-like output. Keep traces internal, don't fine-tune on amplifying it

Watch the **healthy-response confound**: a patch that makes the model robotic and stops it from ever expressing difficulty will show as 'fixed' but may have just suppressed signal.
